as_told.title: Legacy programs hidden under Manhattan Project / Atomic Energy Act secrecy

plain: The claim is that crashed UFO material found in the 1940s was put under the same secrecy as the atomic bomb: first held by the Manhattan Project, then passed to the Atomic Energy Commission, which took over the bomb work after the war, and later to the Department of Energy. A former US intelligence officer named David Grusch tells Michels this, saying the Manhattan Project "would have custody of it, and then it would go into the Atomic Energy Commission." Michels later repeats Grusch in a different way: the atomic secrecy system was laid over UFO secrecy, and the same Manhattan Project people ran both. An analyst named Matthew Pines, also citing Grusch, says these programmes were "tucked underneath the architecture of secrecy" of the Manhattan Project, with the Atomic Energy Act, the law that governed atomic secrets, as their framework through the 1940s, 50s and 60s. If true, it would explain why UFO secrets have been as hard to reach as nuclear ones.
